Every documented instance where the RCMP received evidence of criminal activity involving political actors or institutional corruption — and declined to lay charges. The pattern of zero accountability.

Eight documented instances. Eight non-prosecutions. The RCMP consistently receives evidence of criminal activity involving political actors and declines to lay charges. This is not a resource issue — the RCMP has a $5.7B annual budget and 30,000+ employees. It is a structural issue: the national police force reports to the government it would need to investigate.
